program.blurb: A big strength block every day, never the same twice, then a stretch for what you trained.
program.about: Strength every day, a body part and a format you have not had yet, then a stretch to close. Chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, glutes, single-leg work, the back of the body and the kettlebell each come in straight sets, supersets, a circuit or an EMOM. The stretch replaces the abs finisher. Both later levels move you a weight up, so this one is for building strength over two months.
